blurb: Experience the thrill of the ice at Fogerty Arena - where community and athletics meet! We are home to two exceptional ice rinks - the North and South Arenas. The North Rink, a symbol of community spirit, complements our original rink, the South Rink, which has been the hub of local hockey since 1982.
